policies.title: Terms and Conditions
policies.meta_title: Wash4You Terms and Conditions for Laundry Services
policies.meta_description: Read Wash4You terms and conditions to understand our laundry and dry-cleaning process, pickup and delivery policies, and customer rights in Delhi and Gurgaon.

sections.heading: General
sections.content: By using Wash4You's services, you accept these Terms & Conditions. These apply to all garments, footwear, accessories, curtains, carpets, and other items provided for laundry, pressing, alteration, repair, or cleaning. Wash4You adheres to standard industry procedures but cannot guarantee outcomes beyond the natural limitations of fabric composition, dyes, and trims. Customers are advised to read these terms before placing an order.

sections.heading: Scope of Services
sections.content: Wash4You provides laundry (wash & fold, wash & iron), dry cleaning, and pressing; shoe and bag cleaning, as well as leather and suede care; curtain and carpet cleaning services. All offerings include complimentary home pickup and delivery within designated service areas, as determined by management. Curtain cleaning includes free removal and reinstallation after service. Typical turnaround time is 5 to 7 working days from the pickup date. No compensation will be provided for delays arising from logistical, environmental, or technical challenges.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.content: Our maximum liability in the event of loss, theft, or damage is limited to five times the service fee for the affected item, excluding curtains, carpets, and leather goods. Items with embellishments such as sequins, beads, lace, or delicate fabrics are processed at the customer's risk. Cleaning methods are chosen based on care labels or professional judgment when absent. No guarantees are made regarding complete stain removal. Wash4You is not liable for color fading or shrinkage caused by poor-quality dyes or fabrics; existing damage or wear and tear; or deterioration of synthetic or leather components including hydrolysis or cracking of PU soles. Internal assessment reports are final and binding in resolving disputes.

sections.heading: Claims & Complaints
sections.content: All claims regarding lost, missing, or damaged items must be submitted within 24 hours of delivery and must include the original invoice. Claims submitted after this period will not be entertained. All approved claims will be settled at the company's discretion, limited to the stated liability cap. Items marked 'cleaned at owner's risk' are not eligible for compensation. Contact details: Email: care@wash4you.in, Phone: +91 63 67 600 500.

sections.heading: Delivery & Storage
sections.content: Delivery is typically completed within 5 to 7 business days. Items left unclaimed beyond 15 days will incur a monthly storage fee of 30% of the invoice amount. Items uncollected for more than 90 days will be treated as abandoned and may be discarded with no liability for articles disposed of after this period.

sections.heading: Payments
sections.content: All prices exclude GST and applicable taxes. Full payment is required before or at the time of delivery. Delayed payments are subject to an annual interest of 18% from the date of invoice. Accepted payment methods include cash, cards, UPI, and other digital platforms.

sections.heading: Customer Responsibilities
sections.content: Customers must ensure all valuables are removed from garments prior to handover; notify if any home treatments or chemicals have been applied; and provide accurate delivery and contact details. Complaints post-delivery will not be considered.

sections.heading: Communication Consent
sections.content: By availing Wash4You services, customers agree to receive communication via SMS, WhatsApp, phone, or email for service and promotional purposes. Transactional messages are mandatory. Promotional messages can be opted out of by contacting the company.

policies.title: Privacy & Security Policy
policies.meta_title: Privacy and Security Policy Wash4You Laundry
policies.meta_description: Read Wash4You's privacy and security policy to understand how we protect your personal data, ensure safe transactions, and maintain confidentiality in Delhi and Gurgaon.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect customer information including: name, address, and contact details; records of services used and payments made; preferences and customer feedback.

sections.heading: How Information is Used
sections.content: Customer data is used to manage logistics including pickups, cleaning, and delivery; send service updates, confirmations, and invoices; enhance service quality; and share promotional offers (not if customer opts out).

sections.heading: Data Protection
sections.content: All information is stored on secure, encrypted servers. Payments are processed through PCI-DSS-compliant gateways. We do not retain credit or debit card information. All employees follow strict confidentiality policies.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.content: Information is shared only with logistics and payment partners under secure agreements. Wash4You does not sell or share data for external marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.content: Our website may use cookies for analytics and user functionality. Cookies do not store sensitive information and can be disabled in browser settings.

sections.heading: Customer Rights
sections.content: Customers may access, update, or request deletion of their personal data by contacting care@wash4you.in.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.content: Personal data is retained only as long as needed for service and regulatory compliance. Anonymized data may be used for reporting or auditing.

policies.title: Refund & Delivery Policy
policies.meta_title: Refund and Delivery Policy Wash4You Laundry Service
policies.meta_description: Discover Wash4You's refund and delivery policy for laundry and dry-cleaning. We ensure smooth, reliable service for all customers in Delhi and Gurgaon.

sections.heading: 1. Delivery & Pickup
sections.content: We offer complimentary pickup and delivery services within operational areas. Curtain cleaning includes free de-installation and reinstallation. Standard turnaround time is 5 to 7 working days. Missed pickups or deliveries may be rescheduled at a nominal charge.

sections.heading: 2. Storage Policy
sections.content: Items unclaimed for over 15 days will incur a storage charge of 30% of the invoice per month. Items not collected within 90 days will be considered abandoned and may be responsibly disposed of.

sections.heading: 3. Refunds & Compensation
sections.content: Refunds are not offered. Any compensation is limited to five times the service charge of the item. Curtains, leather items, and carpets are not eligible for compensation. Items designated as 'owner risk' (including delicate or embellished garments) are excluded from claims. All claims must be made within 24 hours of delivery.

sections.heading: 4. Service Limitations
sections.content: Full stain removal is not guaranteed. We are not liable for issues resulting from poor-quality materials or construction. For curtain de-installation/removal or re-installation: where rods, brackets or fixtures are weak, faulty or previously damaged, Wash4You is not responsible for any resulting damages. Alteration, darning, and repair services are permanent and non-refundable.

sections.heading: 5. Payment & Disputes
sections.content: Payments are due prior to or upon delivery. Late payments attract 18% annual interest from the invoice date. Disputes related to the invoice must be raised within 24 hours of receipt.

sections.heading: Contact Information

sections.heading: Free Pickup & Delivery Policy
sections.content: Free Home Pickup and Delivery apply to orders within the service area as decided by management from time to time. Availability depends on logistics routes and operating hours. If the customer is unavailable during pickup/delivery, redelivery may be rescheduled at a nominal fee. For gated communities, customers must ensure access for Company personnel.

sections.heading: Legal Jurisdiction
sections.content: All legal matters fall under the jurisdiction of courts in Gurugram, Haryana, India. Wash4You reserves the right to revise these terms without prior notice. Wash4You reserves the right to refuse service at its discretion. These Terms & Conditions constitute the entire agreement between the customer and Wash4You.
